change_summary.intent: Restore qualification wiring, align the development engine API with the landed module adapter, register dormant migration suites, align Python executable-test discovery with native JSX/TSX and declaration rules, and make legacy source-check workflows read-only. Outliers affecting a minority of batches can now pass, including scheduling disturbances or sporadic leakage; persistent content-dependent early exits remain a required negative control. This coarse regression guard does not certify rare/tail leakage or side-channel soundness. The mutation floor retains all three configured source files and 2500 bp, requires the pinned tool schema, and refuses absent/empty/unknown outcomes and rounded-up sub-floor ratios.
